main_theorem_summary: For mutually independent scalar X and R2 banks U,V with caps 1,M_U,M_V, arbitrary symmetric A,C, arbitrary invertible 2x2 B, p,q and a, Q=aX^2+2Xp^TU+2Xq^TV+U^TAU+2U^TBV+V^TCV+affine has phi_Q in L1 and continuous C0 density whenever d_B=a-2p^TB^{-T}q+q^TB^{-1}AB^{-T}q is nonzero, with ||p_Q||inf <= C0(M_U M_V)^(2/5)|det B|^(-2/5)|d_B|^(-1/5), C0=4.67149102355819. The reverse orientation uses d_B^(V)=a-2q^TB^{-1}p+p^TB^{-T}CB^{-1}p. The proof uses the exact slope r=B^TU+qX, account02/B01 scalar L4 square-phase theorem, and 2D original-bank Plancherel; no pointwise scalar decay is used.
e2_synthesis_summary: If Q=a(X0+h(Y))^2+R(Y), a!=0, and R has a residual original-bank cross block with Z=e_2(M^TM)>0, then the row-gate-free E2 half-Riesz theorem plus the exact square-density kernel gives ||p_Q||inf <= 8e^(1/4)|a|^(-1/2)Z^(-1/8). Essential boundedness only; continuity not claimed by this synthesis.
